ننشوي (form VII)
# نَنْشَوِي (nanšawī) /nan.ʃa.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْشَوَى (inšawā)
# نَنْشَوِيَ (nanšawiya) /nan.ʃa.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَوَى (inšawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
